title: quercus aegilops subsp. persica
intro: Quercus aegilops subsp. persica, commonly known as Persian oak, is a subspecies of Quercus aegilops, a deciduous tree native to the mountainous regions of Iran. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, and is used to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Quercus aegilops subsp. persica include anti-arthritic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-inflammatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins. The bioactive constituents of this plant are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine in Iran.
